source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: مرة، كنت ماشي بالسوق وشفت وجه بعرفه.
sentences.en: Once, I was walking in the market and saw a face I knew.

sentences.ar: قربت شوي وعرفت إنه صاحبي القديم زياد.
sentences.en: I got a bit closer and realized it was my old friend Ziad.

sentences.ar: ما كنا شفنا بعض من أيام المدرسة.
sentences.en: We hadn't seen each other since our school days.
We hugged and laughed and remembered the old days.
We sat at a nearby café and talked for two hours.

sentences.ar: حكالي إنه صار عنده عيلة وولاد.
sentences.en: He told me he now had a family and children.
And I told him about my work and my life.
Before we parted, we exchanged numbers.

sentences.ar: من يومها، صرنا نشوف بعض كل أسبوع.
sentences.en: Since that day, we started seeing each other every week.
